sections.content: To say you like doing something in general, use szeretek (the indefinite 'I like') followed by an infinitive ending in -ni. No specific object is named -- the activity itself is the point.

items.english: What do you do in your free time?

sections.content: szabadidőben uses the inessive -ben ('in') on szabadidő ('free time') -- 'in my free time'. Since szabadidő has front vowels, the suffix is -ben, not -ban.
